newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia stocks slip in dull trade, Daugavpils up.
newsitem.headline: Latvia stocks slip in dull trade, Daugavpils up.

text.p: Latvian stocks had a dull day on Monday although Daugavpils Chain jumped on large turnover, making up most of the bourse's trade, dealers said.
Turnover came to 129,000 lats versus 133,000 lats. Rietumu Bank's index Rietumu added 0.17 percent to 198.86.
Two secondary list shares led the market. Daugavpils Chain was most traded on volume of 55,100 lats and jumped 20 santimes to 2.60 lats.

"Market players were expecting Daugavpils Chain's growth but its size was affected by the fact that most money today was focused on buying Riga Shipyard shares," Dmitri Krutik, Rietumu Bank's equities head, said in a statement on the market.
"Had it not been for the Riga Shipyard auction today, Daugavpils price would have advanced much more," he added.
The bourse earlier announced that an auction for cash of Riga Shipyard shares was sold out at a price of 1.39 lats.
Salacgriva95 fish cannery saw trade of 40,200 lats and it rose to 5.20 lats from 5.25.
Lode Brick was up to 2.60 lats from 2.45 lats on trade of 7,800 lats. The company earlier said it saw good first quarter figures, which are now scheduled for Wednesday.
Official list shares were mostly stable except for Riga Transport Fleet, which traded 6,700 lats and edged lower to 1.61 lats from 1.62 lats.

Fellow official list share and usual market leader Unibanka had volume of 3,800 lats as it remained unchanged at 3.80 lats and Staburade confectionery stayed put at 2.61 lats as it traded 2,400 lats of shares.
Other secondary market shares were dull. Among stocks, showing signs of slight activity were Ogre forestry and Riga Agriculture machine factory.
Ogre traded 2,500 lats of shares and dived some 15 percent to 0.74 santimes and Riga Agriculture machines advanced three santimes to 0.29 santimes on volume of 2,400 lats.
